correctness.rationale: The exact defect formula follows from the product Fourier factorization and the same-sign quadrant multiplier of H1H2-I. The half-Sobolev limit is an extended-valued dominated-convergence/Fatou statement with J(s)<=s and J(s)/s->1. For finite-jump cutoffs, the distributional derivative gives the 1/xi Fourier tail; diagonal jump terms produce the logarithmic coefficient while cross terms are oscillatory lower-order terms.

originality.rationale: The closest 2026 source gives only an upper-order estimate for one hard cutoff and does not state the arbitrary-cutoff kernel identity, the H^{1/2} characterization, the jump-count asymptotic, or the exact 2/pi leading constant. Targeted literature and SCOPE-archive searches did not locate equivalent coverage. The source is very recent and older product-Hardy-space terminology remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact regularity threshold governing truncated eigenstrip defects, supplies a converse, distinguishes smooth and jump cutoffs, and sharpens the motivating construction to an explicit leading asymptotic.
